title: wk-ptybuild: ConPTY helper build launcher
desc: Repo-root pace-exempt launcher (./wk-ptybuild.cmd) that runs tools/wkstdpty.ps1 -BuildOnly to csc-compile wkstdpty/wkcodex-status-pty.cs into .tmp/wkharness/wkstdpty.exe. Use to compile-verify the ConPTY C# helper after any edit. Created 2026-06-30.
steps: WHAT: ./wk-ptybuild.cmd runs tools/wkstdpty.ps1 -BuildOnly, which invokes csc.exe (.NET FW 4.0) on wkstdpty/wkcodex-status-pty.cs and writes .tmp/wkharness/wkstdpty.exe, printing the exe path on success or csc errors on failure. wk-prefixed repo-root WillKim tool = PACE-EXEMPT (runs at pace-95).

USE: compile-verify the ConPTY helper after any edit to wkcodex-status-pty.cs -- a clean build is the gate before relying on it. After build, capture is driven by wk-codex-pty-test / wkpace-codex.cmd -RefreshCli.

CONTEXT: the .cs implements the Win32 ConPTY wrapper (harness-codex-pace-guard-howto step 7) that captures codex boot status bar (5h/weekly percent) for codex_balance.json. Source now lives COMMITTED at wkstdpty/ (was lost as .tmp-only). Cross: harness-codex-pace-guard-howto, wkpace-codex, verify-tool-or-guard-synthetic-live-static.
author: claude
